task_completion.description: The floor plan is divided into distinct zones using partition walls and at least 4 doors.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for new wall segments and at least 4 door icons/models placed within the floor plan in the 2D or 3D view.

task_completion.description: At least 3 treatment operatories are created, each containing a dental chair, a cabinet/shelf, and a lamp.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Identify three separate rooms/areas each containing a dental chair model, a storage unit (cabinet/shelf), and a light fixture/lamp.

task_completion.description: The reception area is furnished with a desk, at least 6 waiting chairs, and 2 side tables.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for a cluster of furniture including one desk, a group of at least 6 identical or similar chairs, and 2 small tables.

task_completion.description: The sterilization zone has 3 shelf units; the break room has a table, chairs, and at least 1 appliance.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Locate a zone with 3 shelves (sterilization) and another zone with a dining-style table, chairs, and an appliance like a fridge or microwave.

task_completion.description: At least 2 toilets and 2 sinks are installed across the facility.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Count at least 2 toilet fixtures and 2 sink fixtures in the floor plan (likely in the restroom or sterilization areas).

task_completion.description: At least 5 zones are identified with text labels (e.g., Operatory, Reception, etc.).
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for text overlays or labels on the 2D floor plan naming at least 5 distinct rooms/areas.

task_completion.description: The changes are saved to the project file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for the agent clicking 'File > Save' or the 'Save' icon, or a terminal command indicating a save operation of the .sh3d file.

integrity.description: The agent used the Sweet Home 3D GUI to place objects and walls.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots should show the mouse cursor interacting with the furniture catalog, the 2D plan, and the 3D view rather than just executing scripts.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply open a pre-completed file.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory should show the step-by-step placement of walls and furniture over time.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the actual Sweet Home 3D software interface.
integrity.visual_evidence: The window decorations, menus, and toolbars must match the Sweet Home 3D environment.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task is performed in Sweet Home 3D. The starter file is 'dental_office_starter.sh3d'. To pass, the agent must achieve a score of at least 70/100 based on the presence of new walls, at least 4 doors, specific furniture counts (3 dental chairs, 6 waiting chairs, 2 toilets, 2 sinks, etc.), and at least 5 text labels. The final file must be saved.
